description: PausePoint Shield Canonical Rule Pack — Shared between TypeScript Web & Kotlin shield-core

levers.label: Urgency
levers.lever: Rushes you so you skip thinking and act on impulse

levers.label: Fear / Threat
levers.lever: Scares you into obeying through penalties, arrest, or disconnection
levers.pattern: \b(blocked|suspended|deactivated|disconnected|disconnection|legal action|arrest(?:ed)?|warrant|penalty|fine of|FIR|seized|frozen|money laundering|drugs?|illegal|band ho jayega|kat jayegi|police karyawahi|giraftar)\b

levers.label: Fake Authority
levers.lever: Borrows the power of a government body, police, or bank to demand compliance

levers.label: Greed / Reward
levers.lever: Dangles unearned cash, lottery, or windfall profits to cloud judgment
levers.pattern: \b(won|winner|lottery|prize|cashback|reward|gift|lucky draw|KBC|refund|bonus|earn (?:rs\.?|₹)?\s?\d[\d,]*|part[- ]time job|work from home|double your|free|guaranteed profit|daily income)\b

levers.label: Secrecy / Isolation
levers.lever: Cuts you off from family, friends, or advisors who would warn you
levers.pattern: \b(don'?t tell (?:anyone|anybody|your family)|do not (?:tell|inform|share with) (?:anyone|anybody|your family)|keep (?:this )?(?:confidential|secret)|stay on (?:the )?(?:call|video)|don'?t disconnect|kisi ko mat batana|raaz rakhna)\b

levers.label: Asks for Secrets
levers.lever: Wants the master keys to your bank account, email, or identity

levers.label: Remote Control / APK Trojan
levers.lever: Attempts to gain screen control or install surveillance software on your device

levers.label: Money Request
levers.lever: The ultimate extraction: pressuring you to transfer funds or scan a QR

levers.label: Fake Familiarity
levers.lever: Pretends to be a loved one, family member, or close contact in distress

levers.label: Curiosity / Sextortion Bait
levers.lever: Tricks you into clicking through shock, leaked photos, or scandal bait
levers.pattern: \b(you won'?t believe|see who|your (?:photo|video) (?:is )?(?:viral|leaked)|private video|check this out|is this you|morphed clip|viral video)\b

levers.label: Scarcity / Social Proof
levers.lever: Manufactures fear of missing out with limited slots or fake testimonials

levers.label: Click / Visit Bait
levers.lever: Directs you to open an external web address or portal

playbooks.name: Digital Arrest / Fake Police
playbooks.truth: Police, CBI, ED, and courts NEVER conduct trials or make arrests over Skype, WhatsApp, or video call. There is no legal procedure called 'digital arrest'.
playbooks.pattern: \b(digital arrest|skype|video call|cbi|ed officer|narcotics|ncb|mumbai police|crime branch|warrant|customs parcel)\b
verifySteps: Hang up immediately — real law enforcement never investigates on Skype or WhatsApp.
Tell a family member or friend right now; isolation is how they keep you trapped.
Report the caller's number to Chakshu (sancharsaathi.gov.in) and 1930.

playbooks.name: Bank / SIM KYC Block Trap
playbooks.truth: Banks never send SMS with external links (.xyz, .top, .live) to update KYC. SIM cards are never disconnected with a 24-hour SMS ultimatum.
verifySteps: Do not click the link in the message.
Open your bank app directly, or check your account by logging in normally.
Call the customer service number printed on the back of your debit card.

playbooks.name: UPI 'Receive Money' Scam
playbooks.truth: You NEVER need to enter your UPI PIN, password, or scan a QR code to RECEIVE money. UPI PIN is exclusively used to SEND money out.
verifySteps: Never enter your UPI PIN unless YOU are making a payment.
If someone says 'scan this QR to get your refund', hang up.
Check your account balance directly in your UPI app — no PIN needed to receive.

playbooks.name: Task / Part-Time Job Scam
playbooks.truth: Legitimate employers never ask you to pay 'recharge fees', 'security deposits', or 'crypto upgrades' to withdraw your earned commission.
verifySteps: Stop paying immediately. Paying more will NOT release your earlier deposits.
Leave the Telegram group — the 'colleagues' showing payouts are all fake or accomplices.
Call 1930 immediately with transaction UTRs to freeze the receiver's account.

playbooks.name: Electricity Disconnection Scam
playbooks.truth: Electricity boards never send SMS from personal 10-digit mobile numbers threatening same-night disconnection with an officer's phone number.
verifySteps: Do not call the 10-digit mobile number given in the SMS.
Check your electricity bill status on the official state electricity board app or portal.
Pay only through official bill payment apps (BESCOM, TNEB, Tata Power, etc.).

playbooks.name: Malicious APK / Trojan Delivery
playbooks.truth: Traffic police (e-challan), banks, and courier companies NEVER deliver apps via .apk links in SMS or WhatsApp. APKs steal OTPs silently.
verifySteps: Do not install or download any file ending in .apk sent over chat or SMS.
If already downloaded, do NOT open it. Immediately go to Settings > Apps and uninstall.
Turn on Google Play Protect in Play Store > Settings.

playbooks.name: Customs / Courier Drug Parcel Trap
playbooks.truth: FedEx, DHL, and India Post do not call customers claiming illegal narcotics were found in their parcel and threatening police arrest.
verifySteps: Track your package on the carrier's official website using your tracking number.
No courier company will transfer your call to 'Mumbai Police' or 'NCB'.
Hang up and do not transfer any 'customs clearance fee'.

playbooks.name: Video Call Sextortion / Blackmail
playbooks.truth: Blackmailers use morphed footage and automated video bots. Paying them NEVER deletes the video; they demand higher amounts every time.
verifySteps: Do NOT pay any money. Extortionists never stop asking once you pay once.
Block the number immediately across WhatsApp and phone calls.
Report the incident on cybercrime.gov.in under 'Crime against Women' or call 1930.

playbooks.name: PAN-Aadhaar Deactivation Scare
playbooks.truth: Income Tax department does not send frantic SMS links threatening Rs 10,000 penalties for Aadhaar-PAN linking via unverified URLs.
verifySteps: Check your PAN-Aadhaar linking status on incometax.gov.in directly.
Never pay linking fines through unknown web links.

playbooks.name: Credit Card Reward Points Expiry Trap
playbooks.truth: Banks never convert reward points to cash via external .cc or .live websites requiring debit/credit card CVV and OTP.
verifySteps: Redeem reward points only inside your official bank mobile app or netbanking.
Never enter your card CVV or OTP on any website sent in an SMS.

playbooks.name: TRAI / DoT SIM Deconnection Notice
playbooks.truth: TRAI is a regulatory authority; it does NOT communicate directly with individual telecom subscribers to disconnect mobile numbers.
verifySteps: TRAI does not disconnect numbers. DoT communicates only through telecom operators.
Call your mobile operator's official customer care (198 or 121) to verify SIM status.

brakeRules.truth: STOP. Legitimate platforms deduct fees from earnings. Demanding upfront deposits to release funds is the signature of a fee-advance trap.
